proof_state.supporting_result: Complete proposed p=2 all-order constant/equality/symmetry theorem from Jacobi energy basis, positive spherical Poisson mixture, Burchard-Hajaiej strict rearrangement and Kalyabin point diagonal; p=1 constant and coincident maximizing sets via moment measures. Revision 1.1 gives local continuation near p=2; revision 1.2 gives sharp fourth-order p=1 constants, unique signed measure extremizers and ordinary nonattainment. Revision 1.3 completes the all-order measure endpoint by contact motion and B-spline peak monotonicity. Revisions 1.4 and 1.5 establish finite-exponent height symmetry and full variation continuation above one. Revision 1.6 establishes global finite-exponent maximizer regularity and the necessary switching Hessian. Revision 1.7 excludes all two-switch finite-exponent variation maximizers without a symmetry assumption. Revision 1.8 gives affine-response identities, excludes midpoint-symmetric three-switch maximizers and restricts the response-minimum location of other three-switch candidates. Revision1.9 rules out the arbitrary derivative-weight extension by an explicit exact certificate and smoothing argument.
